title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode6 A Sudden Occurrence

meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Seaside School - Day 3
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Today's finally the day!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Time flew by so fast...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we were solid during rehearsals. All that's left to do is to blow everyone away♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Let's make our performance really really wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, time to win it all!
Le Lion, here we come!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Sorry to interrupt, but the teachers said that this is the only place we can practice before we go on stage.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we leave these boxes here? They have our costumes and stuff in them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Here, I'll move my drums to give you some space.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll help you, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Thank you so much. We'll try to stack them so they don't take up too much space.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
And... Up you go...
Let's see... One, two three, four...
Okay, why don't we throw this last one up there too?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Are you sure? It might fall over...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: It's a common practice area, so we don't have much of a choice. We can't hog this space, so... Up you... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! Emu! Watch out!
se_event_summer_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami! Emu! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I think so...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Mochizuki, I'm so sorry!
Are you sure you're okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I got out of the way just in time. Luckily, Saki was there to warn us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: More importantly, the drums...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh no...
The head got torn...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! No!
Does that mean we can't use it now...?!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
I... I'm so sorry...!
I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, really, it's okay!
We'll figure something out. You two should go back to getting ready for your own presentation.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do we do...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's only one set in the whole lodge, right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No... Isn't there anything we can do? We won't be able to perform without that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'd finally figured out what to do and practiced so much to get it just right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait, I know...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll go ask the teachers to see if we can borrow another drum kit. Please wait here in the meantime...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona?!
Lodge Gym
se_event_summer_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, Mochizuki.
You seem like you're in a big hurry. Is everything alright?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, no, the drum kit we were going to use for our performance accidentally broke...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
It did?
I hope no one got hurt...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luckily, nobody did. However, we heard that there was only one drum kit available here, and were wondering if we could borrow another one from somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would that be possible?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Understood...
I'll try talking to someone I know at one of the schools nearby. Would you mind waiting while I call them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They said we could borrow another drum kit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, a teacher managed to get a hold of an acquaintance from a nearby school and asked them if we could.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But they also said that it would take about 40 minutes to go there, get it and come back...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, what are you all doing here? It's about to start, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have a slight emergency on our hands...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And now you have no drums...
But doesn't your group go last?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we wouldn't make it back in time even if we went out and get it right now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can't perform without it, right? I say go and get it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you're going last, we might be able to get the teachers to add a quick intermission to buy you some time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that might be the answer...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll have to ask each teacher and group since it's probably going to affect the rest of today's schedule.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
But I'm for your idea, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll stay here and do everything I can to buy us as much time as possible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! We can work together, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll help Honami find a way to get that drum kit over here. I'm sure you'll need an extra set of hands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much...!
Then we should get going, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come back safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll do what I can to help too, since my group isn't on until later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, it's brainstorming time! Let's buy Honami and Kohane as much time as we can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm starting to think that an intermission won't give us enough time. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You might be right. I'm guessing they're going to need around 15 minutes to carry something like that back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it wouldn't really be a quick intermission then, would it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have a feeling that everyone would be okay with it, but I'd feel so bad about making them wait for that long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Unless, we can come up with something to do during that time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Emu! Emu!
Can I ask you something really quick?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: M-Miku...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, uh... I think someone's calling me...! Sorry, I'll be right back...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, we should be fine here. You want to ask me something, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<About that.
*Whisper*>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Yeah, that sounds super fun! I might actually be able to if you're there to help me, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll go tell Saki right now!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Saki! Shiho!
I got an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We just need to come up with a second performance!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, they gave us the green light!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After I explained our situation to them, they said we could have a 10-minute break and a 5-minute slot for our second performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also, here.
That other group said that you could borrow their props, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
I'll make sure to thank them after we're done!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's going to be my first time, so I'm not sure if I'll be able to do it right... But I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's make it a big success!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you're almost up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, wish us luck!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shiho!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Break a leg, you two...
